cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Jacob Strand, New York, NY, 1920s; Paul Strand, New York, NY, date unknown; The New Gallery, New York, NY, 1950; Parke-Bernet Galleries, New York, NY, sale no. 1316, lot no. 41, 21 February 1952; (Lock Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New Jersey, 1952; Parke-Bernet Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 1446, lot no. 50, 12 November 1953; The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY, 1953; Private collection, New York, NY, 1953; Private collection, New York, NY, date unknown; (Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); Kay Hillman, New York, NY, 1973; Kennedy Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1973; Private collection, Wayne, New Jersey, 1973; Kennedy Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1973 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Mr. Strand's house, Feb. 1946. . . . No signature [notes backing inscription]. . . Purple grapes on white plate. White background. Owned Mr. Jacob Strand. . . Parke–Bernet Galleries, Inc, Nov. 12, 1953 . . . A bunch of large blue grapes is depicted on a white porcelain plate against a grayish–white tablecloth. . . . Note: Miss Appleton attended the above sale. Said the picture bought in by Mrs. Halpert (Downtown Gallery) for $575. This prob. same picture as above but check to see if from the Strand estate." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Had belonged to Jacob Strand." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A cluster of dark, purplish-black grapes rest on a white plate with a brown stem extending out to the right edge of the landscape-oriented composition. The plate sits on an undulating white surface that resembles fabric.
